Section 2 - Purpose
(1)
This Policy and associated procedures affirm the commitment La Trobe University has to the health and safety of all members within the University Community in preventing both physical and psychological workplace injuries, disease and ill health through a prevention led, systematic and risk-based approach.

Section 3 - Scope
(2)
This Policy applies to:
all staff and members of the University Community (including Council members, volunteers, students, contractors and associates);
all University campuses and research areas.
